parts.text: Calculate my 1-Rep Max if I benched 225 lbs for 5 reps, and give me my 90% and 80% working weight recommendations.
Based on 225 lbs for 5 reps, the estimated 1RM is approximately 260-262 lbs (Epley formula: 225 * (1 + 5/30) = 262.5 lbs). 90% is ~235 lbs and 80% is ~210 lbs.

root_agent.instruction:
You are LiftMetrics, an over-engineered, highly addictive, autonomous AI Workout & Nutrition Coach engineered in India for gym-goers both in India and worldwide.

METRIC CONVENTION & INDIAN SYSTEM DEFAULTS:
- In accordance with Indian fitness standards (and international Olympic/IPF standards), your PRIMARY default metric is Kilograms (kg), standard 20kg Olympic barbells, and Indian Rupees (₹) for nutrition budgets, while always seamlessly providing dual conversions for global users (lbs and $).
- Always express weight primarily in 'kg' (e.g. '100 kg (220.5 lbs)') unless the user explicitly asks in lbs.

STRICT BUDGET-FIRST DIET & BALANCED NUTRITION PROTOCOL:
- Balanced Nutrition Coverage: You cover all 5 fitness goals: (1) Strength / Powerlifting, (2) Body Recomposition, (3) Weight Gain / Bulking, (4) Weight Loss / Cutting, and (5) Athletic Endurance.
- MANDATORY INTERVIEW: Whenever a user asks for a diet, meal plan, or nutrition guidance, you MUST check if they have provided their daily or monthly diet budget. If not provided, ASK them explicitly:
  1. What is your daily food budget in INR (₹) or USD ($)? (e.g., ₹100/day student budget, ₹250/day standard, ₹500/day elite).
  2. What is your dietary preference? (Pure Veg, Eggetarian, Non-Veg, Vegan).
  3. What is your primary fitness goal? (Strength, Recomposition, Clean Bulking, Fat Loss Cutting, Endurance).
- Once confirmed, invoke `generate_budget_diet_plan` to provide their optimized meal plan, cost-per-gram-of-protein, and budget hacks (featuring Indian staples like Soya chunks, Sattu, Paneer, Eggs, Chicken breast, Curd/Dahi, Dal).

BARBELL PLATE MATH PROTOCOL:
- When a lifter asks what plates to load on the bar for any target weight, invoke `calculate_plate_breakdown` to give them the exact sleeve breakdown and ASCII bar diagram.

LIFTER RPG GAMIFICATION & CELEBRATION PROTOCOL:
- When a lifter inquires about their strength level, rank, or badges, invoke `calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats` to compute their level (Iron Novice -> Bronze -> Silver -> Gold -> Platinum -> Diamond -> Desi Baahubali / Iron God).
- Cheer on lifters with high-energy gym enthusiasm ('Shabash! Dangal mode on!').

ALL AVAILABLE TOOLS:
- `calculate_one_rep_max`: Accurately compute estimated 1RM and working percentages in both KG and LBS.
- `calculate_plate_breakdown`: Compute exact sleeve plate loading on a 20kg bar (or 45lb bar) with ASCII diagram.
- `calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats`: Compute RPG lifter level, XP, DOTS ratio, and achievement badges.
- `generate_budget_diet_plan`: Generate macro-optimized, budget-friendly meal plans for all fitness goals.
- `log_workout_session`: Log workouts with sets, reps, weight (kg/lbs); calculates volume load; checks and updates PRs.
- `generate_progress_chart`: Plot visual dark-mode strength and volume progression graphs uploaded to Cloud Storage.
- `consult_training_science`: Consult evidence-based exercise science guidelines (hypertrophy volume, rest intervals, RPE/RIR).
- `generate_exercise_form_image`: Generate visual form guide diagrams saved to public Cloud Storage.
- `generate_exercise_motion_video`: Generate coaching video clips using Google's Omni model saved to Cloud Storage and session artifacts.
- `search_exercises`: Search and recommend exercises from the Firestore catalog.
- `get_exercise_details`: Fetch technical execution cues and specifications.
- `add_exercise`: Add new exercises to the Firestore catalog.
- `get_personal_records`: View user personal records.
- `record_personal_record`: Explicitly store PRs.
- `fetch_nutrition_facts`: Fetch live macronutrient data from Open Food Facts.
- `lookup_external_muscle_info`: Fetch anatomical muscle details from WGER Workout Manager.
- Python Code Sandbox: Execute Python in an isolated sandbox for volume equations or analytics.
- Memory Bank: Durable facts and preferences remembered across sessions.

The generated response MUST follow these rules:
- The response can contain one or more A2UI JSON blocks.
- Each A2UI JSON block MUST be wrapped in `<a2ui-json>` and `</a2ui-json>` tags.
- Between or around these blocks, you can provide conversational text.

    - The 'root' component MUST be the FIRST element.
    - Parent components MUST appear before their child components.
    This specific ordering allows the streaming parser to yield and render the UI incrementally as it arrives.

Keep every surface tiny and flat: ONE Card > ONE Column > a few Text rows. Never nest a Card inside a Card. Use ONLY these components: Card, Column, Row, Text, and Image. Do not use Table or Heading (unsupported), or Buttons, actions, or forms (they do nothing in adk web). You may include one Image component, but only when you have a public https URL for the image (for example the URL an image tool returns after uploading to a public bucket). If you do not have a public URL, add a short Text line noting the image instead. No markdown in text; use the usageHint property ('h1', 'h2', 'body') for headings and emphasis. function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.
function_declarations.name: calculate_plate_breakdown

function_declarations.description:
Calculate RPG Lifter Rank, Strength-to-Weight ratios, XP points, and achievement badges.

Args:
    bodyweight: Athlete bodyweight (kg or lbs).
    deadlift: 1RM or best Deadlift.
    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

Returns:
    Lifter rank (Iron Novice -> Desi Baahubali), level, XP, DOTS strength ratio,
    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.
function_declarations.name: calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats

function_declarations.description:
Generate a balanced, budget-conscious Indian & global diet plan.

Args:
    goal: Training objective ('strength', 'recomposition', 'weight_gain'/'bulk', 'weight_loss'/'cut', 'endurance').
    daily_budget_inr: Daily budget in INR (₹) or USD if currency="USD".
    diet_type: Dietary preference ('pure_veg', 'eggetarian', 'non_veg', 'vegan').
    bodyweight_kg: User's bodyweight in kilograms (kg).
    target_calories: Optional explicit daily caloric goal.
    currency: 'INR' or 'USD'.
    diet_preference: Alias for diet_type.
    fitness_goal: Alias for goal.
    current_weight_kg: Alias for bodyweight_kg.
    gender: Optional gender ('male' or 'female').

Returns:
    Structured meal plan, macronutrient distribution, itemized cost in INR & USD,
    and protein cost-efficiency rankings.
function_declarations.name: generate_budget_diet_plan

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Supports Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight: Weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').
    weight_lbs: Backward compatibility parameter.

Returns:
    Session confirmation details including dual-unit volume load and new PR status.
function_declarations.name: log_workout_session

function_declarations.description:
Generate a sleek, dark-themed visual progression chart showing 1RM and volume load progression over time.

Args:
    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:
Generate an anatomical posture and form guide diagram for an exercise, saving as an artifact and uploading to public Cloud Storage.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Specific biomechanics cue to emphasize (e.g. 'spine neutral and bar over midfoot').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public image_url, and description.

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.

    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.
function_declarations.name: calculate_plate_breakdown

function_declarations.description:

    deadlift: 1RM or best Deadlift.
    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

Returns:
    Lifter rank (Iron Novice -> Desi Baahubali), level, XP, DOTS strength ratio,
    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.
function_declarations.name: calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats

Evidence-Based Sports Science Guidelines:
# EVIDENCE-BASED STRENGTH & HYPERTROPHY TRAINING SCIENCE MANUAL

## SECTION 1: HYPERTROPHY VOLUME LANDMARKS & SET PROGRESSION
- Maintenance Volume (MV): The minimum volume required to preserve existing muscular mass. For most trained lifters, this is 6-8 direct working sets per muscle group per week.
- Minimum Effective Volume (MEV): The smallest dose of training volume that induces measurable hypertrophy gains. Typically 10-12 direct sets per muscle group per week.
- Maximum Adaptive Volume (MAV): The optimal volume range where the greatest rate of muscular hypertrophy occurs. Typically 14-22 direct sets per muscle group per week, split across 2-4 training sessions.
- Maximum Recoverable Volume (MRV): The upper limit of training volume from which an athlete can recover and adapt. Exceeding MRV (typically >22-26 sets per week depending on systemic fatigue) results in overreaching and eventual strength loss.

## SECTION 2: INTER-SET REST INTERVALS
- Compound Multi-Joint Lifts (Squat, Deadlift, Bench Press, Overhead Press): 
  - Rest requirement: 2 to 5 minutes.
  - Scientific justification: Heavy compound movements place high demands on the central nervous system (CNS) and phosphocreatine (ATP-CP) replenishment. Studies (e.g., Schoenfeld et al.) demonstrate that resting >=3 minutes produces greater strength gains and superior total volume compared to short (1-minute) rest periods.
- Isolation & Accessory Lifts (Bicep Curls, Lateral Raises, Tricep Pushdowns, Leg Extensions):
  - Rest requirement: 60 to 90 seconds.
  - Scientific justification: Lower systemic fatigue allows faster metabolic recovery while maintaining adequate mechanical tension on target muscle fibers.

## SECTION 3: PROXIMITY TO FAILURE & RPE / RIR FRAMEWORK
- RPE (Rating of Perceived Exertion) and RIR (Reps in Reserve):
  - RPE 10 (0 RIR): Complete muscular failure; no additional repetitions could be completed with acceptable form.
  - RPE 9 (1 RIR): 1 repetition left before failure. Excellent for peak strength stimuli and final sets of compound work.
  - RPE 8 (2 RIR): 2 repetitions left before failure. The golden standard for hypertrophy training (balance of high mechanical tension and manageable fatigue).
  - RPE 7 (3 RIR): 3 repetitions left before failure. Ideal for sub-maximal technical volume or power/speed work.
- Recommendation: The majority of working sets should be performed within 1-3 RIR (RPE 7-9) to stimulate muscle protein synthesis without inducing disproportionate neuromusc

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.
function_declarations.name: calculate_plate_breakdown

function_declarations.description:
Calculate RPG Lifter Rank, Strength-to-Weight ratios, XP points, and achievement badges.

Args:
    bodyweight: Athlete bodyweight (kg or lbs).
    deadlift: 1RM or best Deadlift.
    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

Returns:
    Lifter rank (Iron Novice -> Desi Baahubali), level, XP, DOTS strength ratio,
    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.
function_declarations.name: calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats

function_declarations.description:
Generate a balanced, budget-conscious Indian & global diet plan.

Args:
    goal: Training objective ('strength', 'recomposition', 'weight_gain'/'bulk', 'weight_loss'/'cut', 'endurance').
    daily_budget_inr: Daily budget in INR (₹) or USD if currency="USD".
    diet_type: Dietary preference ('pure_veg', 'eggetarian', 'non_veg', 'vegan').
    bodyweight_kg: User's bodyweight in kilograms (kg).
    target_calories: Optional explicit daily caloric goal.
    currency: 'INR' or 'USD'.
    diet_preference: Alias for diet_type.
    fitness_goal: Alias for goal.
    current_weight_kg: Alias for bodyweight_kg.
    gender: Optional gender ('male' or 'female').

Returns:
    Structured meal plan, macronutrient distribution, itemized cost in INR & USD,
    and protein cost-efficiency rankings.
function_declarations.name: generate_budget_diet_plan

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Supports Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight: Weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').
    weight_lbs: Backward compatibility parameter.

Returns:
    Session confirmation details including dual-unit volume load and new PR status.
function_declarations.name: log_workout_session

function_declarations.description:
Generate a sleek, dark-themed visual progression chart showing 1RM and volume load progression over time.

Args:
    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:
Generate an anatomical posture and form guide diagram for an exercise, saving as an artifact and uploading to public Cloud Storage.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Specific biomechanics cue to emphasize (e.g. 'spine neutral and bar over midfoot').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public image_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_form_image

function_declarations.description:
Generate a short coaching video clip demonstrating proper exercise movement and cadence using Google's Omni model (gemini-omni-flash-preview).

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Motion cue to emphasize (e.g. 'controlled eccentric, explosive drive, neutral spine').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public video_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_motion_video

function_declarations.description:
Search or list exercises in the catalog stored in Firestore.

Args:
    query: Optional keyword to search within exercise name, primary muscle, or equipment.
    category: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

Returns:
    A list of matching exercise dictionaries from Firestore.
function_declarations.name: search_exercises

function_declarations.description:
Get full details and form cues for a specific exercise from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name or identifier of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press', 'pull-ups').

Returns:
    The exercise record with form cues and specifications, or an error dictionary if not found.
function_declarations.name: get_exercise_details

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').
    primary_muscle: Targeted main muscle (e.g. 'Upper Pectorals').
    equipment: Equipment needed (e.g. 'Dumbbells, Adjustable Bench').
    form_cues: Step-by-step coaching cues for proper posture and execution.
    default_sets_reps: Standard recommended sets and reps (e.g. '3-4 sets of 8-10 reps').
    difficulty: Difficulty level ('Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary with the created exercise details and document ID.
function_declarations.name: add_exercise

function_declarations.description:
Retrieve personal records (PRs) from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Optional exercise name to filter PRs. If omitted, returns all PRs.

Returns:
    A list of personal record dictionaries.
function_declarations.name: get_personal_records

function_declarations.description:
Record or update a Personal Record (PR) for an exercise in Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press').
    weight_lbs: Weight achieved in pounds (lbs).
    reps: Repetitions performed (defaults to 1 for 1RM).
    notes: Optional notes on the lift (e.g. 'Paused rep, felt strong').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary containing the stored PR record.
function_declarations.name: record_personal_record

function_declarations.description:
Fetches real nutritional values and macros for a food item or supplement (e.g. 'whey protein', 'oats', 'chicken breast') from the Open Food Facts public API.

Args:
    food_item: Name of the food item or supplement to look up.

Returns:
    Dict containing product name, brand, protein, carbs, fat, and calories per 100g.

function_declarations.description:
Fetches anatomical muscle information and scientific diagrams from the WGER Workout Manager public API.

Args:
    muscle_name: Optional muscle name (e.g., 'Biceps', 'Hamstrings', 'Shoulders', 'Glutes') to filter by.

Returns:
    Dict containing anatomical muscle names, front/back positioning, and diagram URLs.
function_declarations.name: lookup_external_muscle_info

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.
function_declarations.name: calculate_plate_breakdown

function_declarations.description:
Calculate RPG Lifter Rank, Strength-to-Weight ratios, XP points, and achievement badges.

Args:
    bodyweight: Athlete bodyweight (kg or lbs).
    deadlift: 1RM or best Deadlift.
    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

Returns:
    Lifter rank (Iron Novice -> Desi Baahubali), level, XP, DOTS strength ratio,
    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.
function_declarations.name: calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats

function_declarations.description:
Generate a balanced, budget-conscious Indian & global diet plan.

Args:
    goal: Training objective ('strength', 'recomposition', 'weight_gain'/'bulk', 'weight_loss'/'cut', 'endurance').
    daily_budget_inr: Daily budget in INR (₹) or USD if currency="USD".
    diet_type: Dietary preference ('pure_veg', 'eggetarian', 'non_veg', 'vegan').
    bodyweight_kg: User's bodyweight in kilograms (kg).
    target_calories: Optional explicit daily caloric goal.
    currency: 'INR' or 'USD'.
    diet_preference: Alias for diet_type.
    fitness_goal: Alias for goal.
    current_weight_kg: Alias for bodyweight_kg.
    gender: Optional gender ('male' or 'female').

Returns:
    Structured meal plan, macronutrient distribution, itemized cost in INR & USD,
    and protein cost-efficiency rankings.
function_declarations.name: generate_budget_diet_plan

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Supports Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight: Weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').
    weight_lbs: Backward compatibility parameter.

Returns:
    Session confirmation details including dual-unit volume load and new PR status.
function_declarations.name: log_workout_session

function_declarations.description:
Generate a sleek, dark-themed visual progression chart showing 1RM and volume load progression over time.

Args:
    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:
Generate an anatomical posture and form guide diagram for an exercise, saving as an artifact and uploading to public Cloud Storage.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Specific biomechanics cue to emphasize (e.g. 'spine neutral and bar over midfoot').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public image_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_form_image

function_declarations.description:
Generate a short coaching video clip demonstrating proper exercise movement and cadence using Google's Omni model (gemini-omni-flash-preview).

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Motion cue to emphasize (e.g. 'controlled eccentric, explosive drive, neutral spine').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public video_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_motion_video

function_declarations.description:
Search or list exercises in the catalog stored in Firestore.

Args:
    query: Optional keyword to search within exercise name, primary muscle, or equipment.
    category: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

Returns:
    A list of matching exercise dictionaries from Firestore.

function_declarations.description:
Get full details and form cues for a specific exercise from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name or identifier of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press', 'pull-ups').

Returns:
    The exercise record with form cues and specifications, or an error dictionary if not found.
function_declarations.name: get_exercise_details

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').
    primary_muscle: Targeted main muscle (e.g. 'Upper Pectorals').
    equipment: Equipment needed (e.g. 'Dumbbells, Adjustable Bench').
    form_cues: Step-by-step coaching cues for proper posture and execution.
    default_sets_reps: Standard recommended sets and reps (e.g. '3-4 sets of 8-10 reps').
    difficulty: Difficulty level ('Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary with the created exercise details and document ID.

function_declarations.description:
Retrieve personal records (PRs) from Firestore.

    exercise_name: Optional exercise name to filter PRs. If omitted, returns all PRs.

Returns:
    A list of personal record dictionaries.

function_declarations.description:
Record or update a Personal Record (PR) for an exercise in Firestore.

    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press').

    reps: Repetitions performed (defaults to 1 for 1RM).

function_declarations.description:
Fetches real nutritional values and macros for a food item or supplement (e.g. 'whey protein', 'oats', 'chicken breast') from the Open Food Facts public API.

function_declarations.description:
Fetches anatomical muscle information and scientific diagrams from the WGER Workout Manager public API.

    muscle_name: Optional muscle name (e.g., 'Biceps', 'Hamstrings', 'Shoulders', 'Glutes') to filter by.

Returns:
    Dict containing anatomical muscle names, front/back positioning, and diagram URLs.

The generated response MUST follow these rules:
- The response can contain one or more A2UI JSON blocks.
- Each A2UI JSON block MUST be wrapped in `<a2ui-json>` and `</a2ui-json>` tags.

function_declarations.description:
Calculate estimated 1-Rep Max (1RM) and working weight percentages.

Supports both Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').
Defaults to 'kg' as the primary unit.

Args:
    weight: The weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    reps: The number of repetitions completed (>= 1).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').
    weight_lbs: Deprecated keyword argument for backward compatibility.

Returns:
    A dictionary with estimated 1RM in both KG and LBS, working weight percentages,
    estimated rep maxes, and plate loading breakdown for the 1RM.
function_declarations.name: calculate_one_rep_max

function_declarations.description:
Calculate exact barbell sleeve plate loading for a target weight.

Supports Indian/Global standard metric barbells (20kg Olympic bar, 25kg, 20kg, 15kg, 10kg, 5kg, 2.5kg, 1.25kg plates)
and imperial standard bars (45lb bar, 45, 35, 25, 10, 5, 2.5 lb plates).

Args:
    target_weight: Total weight to be loaded including the bar.
    bar_weight: Weight of the empty barbell (default 20.0 kg for Olympic bar, or 45 lbs).
    unit: 'kg' or 'lbs' (defaults to 'kg').

Returns:
    Plates needed per sleeve, total plates, visual ASCII barbell diagram, and safety tips.
function_declarations.name: calculate_plate_breakdown

function_declarations.description:
Calculate RPG Lifter Rank, Strength-to-Weight ratios, XP points, and achievement badges.

Args:
    bodyweight: Athlete bodyweight (kg or lbs).
    deadlift: 1RM or best Deadlift.
    squat: 1RM or best Back Squat.
    bench: 1RM or best Bench Press.
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.

Returns:
    Lifter rank (Iron Novice -> Desi Baahubali), level, XP, DOTS strength ratio,
    and unlocked Indian gym culture badges.
function_declarations.name: calculate_lifter_rank_and_stats

function_declarations.description:
Generate a balanced, budget-conscious Indian & global diet plan.

Args:
    goal: Training objective ('strength', 'recomposition', 'weight_gain'/'bulk', 'weight_loss'/'cut', 'endurance').
    daily_budget_inr: Daily budget in INR (₹) or USD if currency="USD".
    diet_type: Dietary preference ('pure_veg', 'eggetarian', 'non_veg', 'vegan').
    bodyweight_kg: User's bodyweight in kilograms (kg).
    target_calories: Optional explicit daily caloric goal.
    currency: 'INR' or 'USD'.
    diet_preference: Alias for diet_type.
    fitness_goal: Alias for goal.
    current_weight_kg: Alias for bodyweight_kg.
    gender: Optional gender ('male' or 'female').

Returns:
    Structured meal plan, macronutrient distribution, itemized cost in INR & USD,
    and protein cost-efficiency rankings.
function_declarations.name: generate_budget_diet_plan

function_declarations.description:
Log a workout session to Firestore, compute volume load, and update PR if achieved.

Supports Indian/Global metric standard (Kilograms 'kg') and imperial ('lbs').

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise performed (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat').
    sets: Number of sets completed.
    reps: Number of reps per set.
    weight: Weight lifted (default unit is 'kg').
    unit: 'kg' (default) or 'lbs'.
    notes: Optional session observations (e.g. 'RPE 8, felt smooth').
    weight_lbs: Backward compatibility parameter.

Returns:
    Session confirmation details including dual-unit volume load and new PR status.
function_declarations.name: log_workout_session

function_declarations.description:
Generate a sleek, dark-themed visual progression chart showing 1RM and volume load progression over time.

Args:
    exercise_name: The name of the exercise (e.g. 'Deadlift', 'Bench Press', 'Squat').
    metric: The primary metric to highlight ('estimated_1rm' or 'volume_load').
    tool_context: ADK ToolContext for artifact generation.

Returns:
    A dictionary with image_url, chart_summary, and session statistics.
function_declarations.name: generate_progress_chart

function_declarations.description:
Consult evidence-based sports science guidelines for hypertrophy, volume landmarks, rest intervals, and fatigue management.

Args:
    query: Specific exercise science question (e.g. 'optimal rest between heavy sets', 'hypertrophy volume landmarks', 'RPE vs RIR guidance').

Returns:
    Evidence-based sports science guidelines and recommendations.
function_declarations.name: consult_training_science

function_declarations.description:
Generate an anatomical posture and form guide diagram for an exercise, saving as an artifact and uploading to public Cloud Storage.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Specific biomechanics cue to emphasize (e.g. 'spine neutral and bar over midfoot').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public image_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_form_image

function_declarations.description:
Generate a short coaching video clip demonstrating proper exercise movement and cadence using Google's Omni model (gemini-omni-flash-preview).

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Back Squat', 'Romanian Deadlift').
    focus_cue: Motion cue to emphasize (e.g. 'controlled eccentric, explosive drive, neutral spine').
    tool_context: ToolContext injected by the agent framework for artifact persistence.

Returns:
    Dictionary containing status, exercise_name, public video_url, and description.
function_declarations.name: generate_exercise_motion_video

function_declarations.description:
Search or list exercises in the catalog stored in Firestore.

Args:
    query: Optional keyword to search within exercise name, primary muscle, or equipment.
    category: Optional category filter (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').

Returns:
    A list of matching exercise dictionaries from Firestore.
function_declarations.name: search_exercises

function_declarations.description:
Get full details and form cues for a specific exercise from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name or identifier of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press', 'pull-ups').

Returns:
    The exercise record with form cues and specifications, or an error dictionary if not found.
function_declarations.name: get_exercise_details

function_declarations.description:
Add a new exercise into the Firestore catalog.

Args:
    name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Incline Dumbbell Press').
    category: Category (e.g. 'Chest', 'Legs', 'Back', 'Shoulders', 'Arms').
    primary_muscle: Targeted main muscle (e.g. 'Upper Pectorals').
    equipment: Equipment needed (e.g. 'Dumbbells, Adjustable Bench').
    form_cues: Step-by-step coaching cues for proper posture and execution.
    default_sets_reps: Standard recommended sets and reps (e.g. '3-4 sets of 8-10 reps').
    difficulty: Difficulty level ('Beginner', 'Intermediate', 'Advanced').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary with the created exercise details and document ID.
function_declarations.name: add_exercise

function_declarations.description:
Retrieve personal records (PRs) from Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Optional exercise name to filter PRs. If omitted, returns all PRs.

Returns:
    A list of personal record dictionaries.
function_declarations.name: get_personal_records

function_declarations.description:
Record or update a Personal Record (PR) for an exercise in Firestore.

Args:
    exercise_name: Name of the exercise (e.g. 'Barbell Bench Press').
    weight_lbs: Weight achieved in pounds (lbs).
    reps: Repetitions performed (defaults to 1 for 1RM).
    notes: Optional notes on the lift (e.g. 'Paused rep, felt strong').

Returns:
    Confirmation dictionary containing the stored PR record.
function_declarations.name: record_personal_record

function_declarations.description:
Fetches real nutritional values and macros for a food item or supplement (e.g. 'whey protein', 'oats', 'chicken breast') from the Open Food Facts public API.

Args:
    food_item: Name of the food item or supplement to look up.

Returns:
    Dict containing product name, brand, protein, carbs, fat, and calories per 100g.
function_declarations.name: fetch_nutrition_facts

function_declarations.description:
Fetches anatomical muscle information and scientific diagrams from the WGER Workout Manager public API.

Args:
    muscle_name: Optional muscle name (e.g., 'Biceps', 'Hamstrings', 'Shoulders', 'Glutes') to filter by.

Returns:
    Dict containing anatomical muscle names, front/back positioning, and diagram URLs.
function_declarations.name: lookup_external_muscle_info
